programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Link Och Mörkrets Krafter
programme.desc: Max och Link bråkar varje gång Link kommer över, så Phoebe tänker ut en plan för att få dem att bli vänner. När Link börjar tillbringa mer tid med Max än med henne blir hon orolig att hennes plan har fungerat för bra.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Ofrivilliga Hjälten
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker komma i gång med superhjälte-träningen, men när hon smyger ut på en fest och räddar en människas liv, ber hon Max att ta åt sig äran, och plötsligt blir han en hjälte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Match med Rektorn
programme.desc: Phoebe upptäcker att Max är den anonyma figuren som ligger bakom det senaste upproriska påhitteti skolan, men närhon vägrar att avslöja hans hemlighet för rektorn får hon ta konsekvenserna.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Att Hitta en Hit

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: The Nanny: O Say, Can You Ski?
programme.desc: Maxwell uses a ski trip with the President to take Fran's mind off trying to get pregnant.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Hanukkah Story
programme.desc: Fran prays for a miracle when Maxwell, Grace and C.C. are lost following a car accident.

programme.title: The Nanny: The In-Law Who Came Forever
programme.desc: Fran's Aunt Frieda evicts Sylvia and Morty from their apartment, forcing them to move into the mansion.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Fran In The Mirror
programme.desc: Fran loses one million dollars after investing it without consulting Maxwell first.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Yummy Mummy
programme.desc: A college visit leads Fran to worry that she embarrasses Brighton.

programme.title: The Nanny: California, Here We Come?
programme.desc: When Maxwell wants to produce a television show, Fran worries about what her moving to California will do to Sylvia.

programme.title: The Nanny: Ma'Ternal Affairs
programme.desc: After confronting Sylvia about her affair, Fran sets out to save her parent's marriage.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Producers
programme.desc: Niles enlists Fran in an effort to impress C.C. by producing a play.

programme.title: The Nanny: The Dummy Twins
programme.desc: Humiliated after C.C. turns down his marriage proposal, Niles decides to quit his job with the Sheffields.

programme.title: The Nanny: Yetta's Lettas
programme.desc: Maxwell battles an old rival for the rights to the story of Yetta's love life.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Route 666 - Pt 2
programme.desc: Al, Peggy, Kelly, Bud, Jefferson, and Marcy find the gold mine in the desert. Al discovers the first gold nugget and everyone but the feeble-minded Kelly winds up with a bag full of gold.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck the Stud
programme.desc: A man offers the Bundy's $10,000 if Buck will breed with his champion dog, Lady Bird. So, Al has to coach Buck into knowing the varieties of breeding with other dogs the proper way.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Top of the Heap
programme.desc: Al Bundy's childhood pal, Charlie Verducci, and the guy's dim-witted son Vinnie, attend a high society fund raiser in this pilot for the short-lived TV series, 'Top of the Heap.'

programme.title: Våra värsta år: She's Having My Baby - Pt 1
programme.desc: Marcy and Jefferson announce that they are expecting a baby, sending Al into pearls of laughter saying that it's the end of Jefferson's life, until Peggy announces the same.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: She's Having My Baby - Pt 2
programme.desc: Peggy and Marcy's constant demands for belly rubbing and expensive baby accessories drive Al crazy, prompting him to make a run for it.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If Al Had a Hammer
programme.desc: When Al unearths his father's old hammer, he decides to turn the garage into his own private room to escape his pregnant wife.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Cheese, Cues and Blood
programme.desc: Kelly earns a quick $1,000 at hustling pool to buy a gown for the local Miss Cheese competition, and a suspicious Al is out for blood, mistakenly thinking that Kelly is into prostitution.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Looking for a Desk in All the Wrong Places
programme.desc: While Peggy is away helping Marcy recover her precious childhood belongings that Jefferson auctioned off and gambled away the money, Al, Kelly, and Bud hold an anti-baby meeting and make plans for a new "Bundy World Order.”

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Buck Has a Belly Ache
programme.desc: While Jefferson suffers through a sympathetic pregnancy, Peggy is upset that Al is immune. Even worse Buck is listless and getting all the attention due Peggy.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: If I Could See Me Now
programme.desc: Al keeps barely avoiding minor accidents, so Bud and Kelly try to convince him to get glasses, but he keeps insisting that his vision is perfect.

programme.title: Cheers: Airport V

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programme.desc: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Call
programme.desc: When bartender Anita Andrews is stabbed to death inside her family's bar, police conclude her killer was the last patron she served that night.

programme.title: On the Case: Shortcut to Murder
programme.desc: Paula Zahn goes beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within America's justice system. A shortcut home from school causes a 14-year-old girl to cross paths with a murderer.

programme.title: On the Case: Secrets From The Grave

programme.title: On the Case: Followed Home

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Young Women Massacred: The Leconte Affair
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Ett officiellt uppdrag blir personligt när Worfs tidigare förälskelse skickas till Enterprise för att medla i en konflikt mellan klingoner och federationen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Way Of The Warrior, Part 1
programme.desc: When the Klingon Empire ends its peace treaty with the Federation, Sisko must help Klingon Starfleet officer Worf decide where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Den elaka Q förvandlar Picard till Robin Hood och skickar honom på en jakt för att tvinga honom att bevisa sin kärlek till en gammal flamma.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Wesleys experiment med warpfält resulterar i att besättningen mystiskt försvinner.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: En spaning efter en spion på Enterprise blir en häxjakt där Picard antyds vara förrädare.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard måste hindra ett laglöst federationsskepp som utför oprovocerade attacker mot ett tidigare fiendeskepp.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Besättningen lämnas hjälplös när Picard kidnappas och tvingas gå ut i krig med en främmande kapten.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Alternate

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Armageddon Game

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Whispers

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Paradise
programme.desc: Sisko and O'Brien are stranded on a planet inhabited by humans who have rejected any form of technology.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadowplay
programme.desc: Odo and Dax try to solve the mystery of an alien planet whose inhabitants are disappearing without explanation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Playing God
programme.desc: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Efter att ha återvänt från platsen för ett uppdrag för åtta år sen stöter Riker på en identiska gengångare som försöker återuppväcka en relation med Troi.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Enterprise är frusen i tiden på gränsen till fullständig tillintetgörelse och Picard måste komma på hur han ska rädda det utan att förstöra skeppet.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: När borgerna återvänder för att slåss mot Federationen stoltserar de med en ny personlighet och frestar Data när de hjälper honom att känna sin första känsla.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Data håller Picard, Troi och Geordi som fångar. Data har lämnat Enterprise och slagit sig samman med sin onda bror Lore som ledare för borgerna.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Medan besättningen är agerar värd till ambassadörer för en främmande ras, är Picard strandsatt på en öde planet med en kvinna som förälskar sig hopplöst i honom.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Survival Instinct
programme.desc: Visitors from the past present Seven with an opportunity to right a wrong.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Barge Of The Dead
programme.desc: B’Elanna struggles with questions of the afterlife and her Klingon heritage.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Tinker, Tenor, Doctor, Spy
programme.desc: The Doctor’s overactive imagination leads Voyager into real trouble.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Alice
programme.desc: Tom’s latest shuttle acquisition blurs the line between man and machine.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Riddles
programme.desc: The crew discovers a new side of Tuvok when an enemy attack leaves him stripped of his Vulcan sensibilities.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Dragon's Teeth
programme.desc: Mysterious corridors in space lead to the discovery of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The NX-01 gets closer to a showdown with the Xindi when Captain Archer takes on an enigmatic passenger: a beautiful slave named Rajiin.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: When Enterprise responds to a distress call from a Vulcan ship stranded in the Delphic Expanse, Archer and his boarding team are attacked by insane zombie-like Vulcans.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: A powerful telepath makes contact with Hoshi and offers to help Enterprise find the Xindi... for a price.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer, Reed and Major Hayes infiltrate a Xindi-Sloth industrial colony to learn more about the weapon of mass destruction that will be used against Earth.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: A spatial distortion leaves Archer unable to form any new long-term memories. Years in the future, he wakes up one morning and is stunned to learn the outcome of the human-Xindi conflict.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Way Of The Warrior, Part 1
programme.desc: When the Klingon Empire ends its peace treaty with the Federation, Sisko must help Klingon Starfleet officer Worf decide where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Way Of The Warrior, Part 2
programme.desc: When the Klingon Empire ends its peace treaty with the Federation, Sisko must help Klingon Starfleet officer Worf decide where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Besättningen lämnas hjälplös när Picard kidnappas och tvingas gå ut i krig med en främmande kapten.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Picard och besättningen upplever motstridiga känslor när Enterprise räddar en allvarligt skadad borg.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Efter att ha avgått som befälhavare för att delta i ett farligt och hemligt uppdrag, tas kommendör Picard till fånga av cardassierna.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Medan Enterprise har en ny, okänslig befälhavare försöker man rädda Picard från cardassierna.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Efter att ha förlorat livet i en överraskningsattack ger Q Picard en chans att ändra sitt öde.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Medan Enterprise bombarderas av dödlig strålning är Picard fångad ombord med ett gäng interstellära tjuvar.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: Klovn: Bedragsholms Slott

programme.title: Klovn: Bispebjerg-tricket

programme.title: Klovn: Kram Och Mugg
programme.desc: Frank väntar otåligt på att vännen och kollegan Casper ska bli bättre och under tiden hjälper han Mia lite halvt i te-butiken. Plötsligt vaknar Casper till och har en ny idé. Mias 12-årige brorson är på besök och Frank tycker att de är konstiga.

programme.title: Klovn: Amatörerna

programme.title: Klovn: Falskt Skit Alarm

programme.title: Klovn: Baked Alaska

programme.title: Klovn: #metoo
